name: Landlord Simulator
summary:
Inheriting a single property and a harsh reality check, you must build a real estate empire from the ground up. Before acquiring your next building, survive the relentless early game by taking on side gigs, completing local quests, and trading stocks, crypto, or metals to accumulate capital. Once you establish a stable financial foundation, expand into a dynamic market where every property presents unique risks, maintenance challenges, and tenant dynamics.

Manage complex tenant relationships through background checks, navigate severe emergencies like drug labs or legal battles, and adapt to shifting market crises and global events. Balance passive income with active management, upgrade your properties to attract high-tier renters, and maintain a solid reputation. From fixing clogged pipes to mastering cashflow management, your decisions determine whether you become a renowned property tycoon or lose everything to bankruptcy.
